name: Negombo–Kochchikade
details: All classes of traffic reached Kochchikade according to the Railway Department account.

name: Nattandiya and Madampe stations
details: The report gives this opening for goods only at the two named stations. Scope is the stations.

name: Chilaw–Puttalam
details: The Railway Department reports commencing the survey for the proposed line.

name: Madampe station
details: The first March 1916 opening admitted all classes of traffic as far as Madampe.

name: Madampe–Chilaw
details: The March opening admitted only goods at Kakkapalliya and Chilaw.

name: Madampe–Chilaw
details: The Governor opened the whole line for all traffic to Chilaw. The March 1915 railway map depicts the section before these documented service openings.

name: Chilaw–Puttalam
details: The report records completion of the survey and estimate for the proposed line during its reporting period.

name: Chilaw–Puttalam
details: The report dates the project commencement to the application for the required land in November 1920.

name: Batticaloa and Trincomalee Light Railways
details: The report describes active bridge works on the two lines. It specifies 5 ft 6 in gauge with light rails.

name: Gal-oya–Trincomalee
details: The report says rails had reached Trincomalee by the end of 1924. Goods and all-traffic openings are recorded separately in 1927.

name: Maho–Kekirawa
details: The report specifies traffic without a class. The 1924 report also gives this opening date and rounds the distance to 32 miles.

name: Chilaw–Mundel
details: The contemporary report attributes the opening to the Governor. The 1925 report p. 60 gives the same date and a distance of 17 miles. Traffic class is unspecified.

name: Mundel–Puttalam
details: Passenger traffic began on the final section north of Mundel.

name: Kekirawa–Polonnaruwa via Gal-oya
details: Passenger service opened between Kekirawa, Gal-oya and Polonnaruwa. Scope is the route through Gal-oya, before through passenger service to the two eastern termini.

name: Gal-oya–Trincomalee
details: The Trincomalee branch opened for goods traffic before its all-traffic opening in May.

name: Gal-oya–Trincomalee
details: The Railway Department distinguishes this all-traffic opening from the January goods opening. The 1926 report p. 3 footnote independently gives this date.

name: Polonnaruwa–Batticaloa
details: The annual report identifies Polonnaruwa–Batticaloa as the last section and records its goods opening. The 1928 report p. 40 confirms the date.

name: Polonnaruwa–Batticaloa
details: The last section opened to all classes of traffic. The 1928 report p. 40 confirms the date. Earlier track and crossing records document construction and presence.
